title: Resident Statements and Payment Terms — Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
The payment terms of Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage are uniform across tiers except for whether a monthly coinsurance statement goes to the resident.

| Tier | Monthly coinsurance statement issued to the resident |
|---|---|
| Medicare Part A Without Supplemental Coverage | Yes |
| Medicare Part A with Medigap Plan A or B | Yes |
| Medicare Part A with Medigap Plan K | Yes |
| Medicare Part A with Medigap Plan L | Yes |
| Medicare Part A with Full-Coinsurance Medigap | No |
| Medicare Part A with QMB Medicaid Crossover | No |

| Term | All six tiers |
|---|---|
| Statement day: calendar day of the month on which statements for the prior service month issue | 5 |
| Resident share due: calendar days after the statement date | 30 |
| Accepted resident payment methods | Check, certified check, ACH, card |
| Largest single card payment accepted | 5000.00 USD |
| Returned (dishonored) payments after which only certified funds are accepted | 2 |
| Rolling lookback for counting returned payments | 12 calendar months |
| Methods accepted once certified funds are required | Certified check |
| Ended coverage closed only once every coinsurance share is settled | Yes |

*Hypothetical illustration:* a statement issued on the 5th is due 30 calendar days after that date; a resident who has had 2 dishonored payments within the 12 calendar months ending on a payment date pays by certified check.
